en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 1.Al-Ḥasan ibn Saʿīd narrated to us saying, “Faḍālah narrated to us from al-Qāsim ibn Burayd, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim

who said, ‘I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh (a) about the inmates of Hell [who are released after their punishment], so he said, “[My father] Abū Jaʿfar used to say, ‘They Will come out from it and will be taken to a spring at the gate of Paradise called the Spring of Life. They will then be showered with its water and their flesh, skin and hair will grow [back] just as plants grow.’”’”
